alias_hits.review_note: FATF is the widely recognized abbreviation for Financial Action Task Force; 金融行动特别工作组 is the official Chinese translation.
CDD stands for customer due diligence; the Chinese translation is the standard equivalent.
All listed English terms are used interchangeably to refer to the financing of terrorism, and they map to the same Chinese term 恐怖融资.
